full_page.content:
Page 2 Cont.
Oct. 17 Richard Livernois - 15 - acute brites and poleo - improving since enrolled last week ....
18 John J. Gulden - 60 - 35 yrs away from Confession, etc ... Now very threatening kidney infection, family anxious .... Enrolled this a.m. 1.00
Page 3
Oct. Mary Maino - 60 - inward cancer - seemingly quite hopeless ... Mary Osius - Elderly lady has room to rent ..... 712 University Pl. - Niagra 0538.
19 June Ar et - 19 - To-day - health.
Sevina Van Maele - has beauty shop on Seymour & Gratiot - not well and cannot ...... Lovenza Quilolo - 48 - in Provid. - Kidney etc trouble. Alfred Evans - 40 - scandalous
21 George John - 43 - Epileptic since 1'2 yrs old. Some times has 3-5-9 in a day. Michael Makowski - 43 - in T.B. Hospital.
24 Mrs. Marg. Edgett - 52 - from Smiths Creek - inward threatening condition.
26 Harry Cameron - 47 - intestinal trouble.
Page 4 Oct. 26 Mrs. Mattie Richmond - 47 - lukemia - Drs gave no hope ... Enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n 23rd (last Thursday) Next day was decidedly better and still improving. Enrolled To-night as perpetual member.
Raymond Smith - 21 - T.B. T.B. - Tuxcedo San.
Sidney Hart - 84 - Baptized yesterday A.M. Not expected to live over night; Enrolled % phone.
Room for rent ...
